question: In which four aims do great-souled ones succeed after obtaining this knowledge?
premises: Great-souled ones obtain a certain knowledge
Dharma, kāma, artha, and mukti are named
inference: Having obtained this knowledge, great-souled ones succeed in dharma, kāma, artha, and liberation
uncertainties: The main verb governing their success is implied rather than stated
plain_english: Having obtained which, great-souled ones succeed in dharma, desire, wealth, and liberation.
